+    Validator methods on the tool's `args_schema` aren't part of it; they run when the
+    tool does.

+    is accepted.

+        shown = schema if isinstance(schema, dict) else {"type": "object"}
+        return Annotated[dict[str, Any], WithJsonSchema(shown)]

+    Validator methods on the tool's `args_schema` aren't part of it; they run when the
+    tool does.

+    is accepted.

+        shown = schema if isinstance(schema, dict) else {"type": "object"}
+        return Annotated[dict[str, Any], WithJsonSchema(shown)]
